items.source_prompt: First-person POV riding a horse at full speed across the plains of Hyrule at sunset. My hands hold the reins in front of the camera while tall grass rushes past on both sides. A herd of wild animals suddenly crosses the path and the horse veers around them. Hyrule Castle sits far on the horizon beneath pink and orange clouds, peaceful adventurous feeling, fluid first-person riding motion.

First-person POV in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. I stand at the edge of an ancient Sheikah tower high above Hyrule, looking down at forests, rivers, distant mountains and Hyrule Castle. My hands leap forward and open a paraglider as I jump from the tower. The camera drops rapidly before the glider catches the wind, creating a sweeping first-person flight over the landscape. Bright adventurous atmosphere, clear blue sky, enormous sense of freedom.

First-person POV running across the crumbling Bridge of Khazad-dûm with the Fellowship. My hands grab the stone railing as the bridge shakes violently. Gandalf stands ahead facing the enormous Balrog emerging from fire and darkness. The creature spreads its flaming wings and cracks a fiery whip across the cavern, sending sparks and debris toward the camera. Terrifying scale, dramatic orange fire against deep black shadows.

First-person POV riding through an ancient cedar forest at dawn. My hands hold the reins while enormous moss-covered trees rise overhead. Tiny white forest spirits slowly turn their heads toward the camera from the branches. The horse suddenly stops. Through the mist ahead, the enormous Forest Spirit silently steps between the trees while animals gather around it. Quiet supernatural awe, painterly Japanese fantasy landscape.

First-person POV in Halo. I leap from a dropship onto a moving alien tank, grab the hull as plasma bolts streak overhead, climb to the turret, and rip open the hatch while the battlefield races beneath me. Epic military sci-fi scale, strong vehicle momentum.

First-person POV in Jurassic Park. I crouch beside a stalled jeep in heavy rain as a T. rex steps into the road. Lightning reveals its full body; it lowers its head toward the camera and roars, shaking rainwater from its teeth. Minimal movement, maximum scale and suspense.
Third-person aerial shot in an Attack on Titan-inspired city. A soldier swings in a sharp arc around a Titan's neck while steam erupts and rooftops blur below. Fast but readable ODM motion.

A premium photorealistic 5-second bullet-time demo. Two samurai swords collide in heavy rain and sparks burst between the fighters. At the peak action moment, time freezes almost completely: bodies, debris, droplets and secondary motion remain perfectly suspended. The camera perform a fast 220-degree orbit through suspended raindrops and sparks. In the final beat, normal time snaps back and the action resolves naturally. Same-moment 4D consistency, impossible viewpoint and crisp cinematic detail.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Keep the existing low front three-quarter opening composition exactly. One rider in dark protective leathers and a white full-face helmet is deeply crouched on one banked blue motorcycle on a wet empty multilane city road. Preserve the road markings, directional arrows, guardrails, building layout, blue fairings, both wheels and the rider's identity. From 0.00 to 0.75 seconds, the short drift entry reaches its peak. At exactly 0.75 seconds physical time stops. From 0.75 through 4.70 seconds the motorcycle and rider are absolutely stationary in WORLD coordinates, not merely moving slowly or staying centered in frame. Both wheels remain over the same patches of asphalt; there is no forward travel, sideways sliding, progressive yaw, wheel rotation, changing lean, rider adjustment, or suspension bounce. Every fine water droplet and tiny hot spark is fixed in the same spatial constellation during that interval. ONLY the camera moves: follow the supplied front-to-side-to-rear orbit, revealing the same frozen machine and suspended spray through genuine viewpoint parallax. Road markings and background structures are fixed world landmarks, not a road scrolling behind a moving vehicle. Apparent screen motion is caused exclusively by the moving viewpoint. At 4.70 seconds physical time resumes for the brief final beat: the bike continues its drift and the suspended particles disperse. Keep this resumption out of the preceding frozen interval. Particle appearance correction only: the coarse reference effect marks the envelope and frozen world positions of wet-road spray, NOT a collection of literal game-engine particles. Within that envelope render optically natural, irregular fine water spray: tiny near-colorless transparent droplets, sparse slender liquid filaments and faint broken mist, with restrained highlights that match the overcast daylight. Do not reproduce opaque white oval beads, gray cuboids, polygon chips, pebbles, plastic pellets, confetti or large glass marbles. Avoid uniform particle sizes, hard sprite edges, faceted shading and oversized blobs. Foot-peg sparks are a few very small hot metal flecks or thin warm glints, not flat orange polygons or a solid flame plume. Keep enough fine suspended spray to read as bullet time, but let the motorcycle remain the hero. Keep the spray envelope and its physical time frozen from 0.75 through 4.70 seconds; the camera reveals that same suspended instant rather than advancing or regenerating the particles. After 4.70 seconds the fine spray resumes naturally with the original action. Do not blur or soften the whole shot to hide the particles. Preserve the approved motorcycle, rider, white helmet, posture, camera trajectory, opening composition, road layout, daylight appearance and existing freeze timing; only the effect's apparent shape, scale, transparency and material realism are being refined.

这个很适合，而且 proxy 与最终效果的反差可以来自“同一套空间关系，不同的光线呈现”：预览里只是中心、圆盘和相机路径，成片里才出现盘后方被透镜抬起的影像、扭曲星光和强烈的尺度感。
有两处值得写准：光子环是光线形成的影像，不是实体圆环；画面中央的黑洞阴影也不等于事件视界本身。 所以“掠过光子环”可以表现为环像在视野边缘迅速扩展、掠出画面，不要做成钻过发光圆门。NASA 黑洞结构说明
建议做 8 秒主片，另输出相同时间轴的 proxy 供对比。下面可以直接接在 /goal 后面：
请制作一段 8 秒、16:9 横屏、电影级黑洞可视化视频：相机从远处缓慢接近一个被明亮吸积盘包围的 Kerr-like 旋转黑洞，沿短弧线绕行，观察盘后方光线被引力透镜弯折、星空发生扭曲，随后沿向内的轨迹迅速接近事件视界附近，以黑洞阴影大幅占据视野的压迫感结束。整体宏大、冷峻、具有物理世界模型的可信感，不是魔法传送门、宇宙漩涡或爆炸场景。
“Kerr-like”表示借鉴旋转黑洞的视觉特征，不要求精确求解 Kerr 度规或宣称完成了广义相对论模拟。优先保持黑洞中心、吸积盘平面、相机路径、背景星空与透镜畸变之间连续一致的关系。采用艺术化的时间压缩，不把 8 秒镜头解释为真实尺度下的物理飞行时长。
黑洞周围是一张薄而有少量厚度的发光吸积盘，中央留有明确内缘与空隙，不是一直铺到黑色中心的实心圆盘。盘面具有细腻流动纹理，内侧较亮，外侧较暗；主色是金橙色与局部黄白色，不让整张盘过曝成纯白。盘两侧可以出现由运动和观察方向造成的亮度不对称，但不对称方向必须随几何关系连续变化，不能随机交换。背景是深黑太空与可追踪的稀疏星点，没有浓密彩色星云、喷流或其他天体。
0–2 秒：相机从略高于吸积盘平面的斜视角缓慢接近，完整交代黑洞阴影和吸积盘。盘的近侧横穿黑洞下方或前方，远侧的部分光线经过弯折，形成拱起在黑洞上方的明亮影像，下方也可出现更细弱的透镜像。必须让这些影像看起来属于同一张盘，不是上下叠放了几张独立圆盘。中央阴影保持极暗，不添加黑色球体的镜面高光、表面纹理或实体外壳。

背景星点在靠近黑洞视方向时逐渐偏移、拉伸成短弧，远离黑洞的星点受影响较小。选取少量容易追踪的亮星，确保其运动是连续透镜映射，而不是粒子随机飘动、全屏液化或整个背景一起旋转。阴影附近出现细窄、明亮而克制的环状光学结构，不使用粗大的霓虹灯管。
